[USER] User inquired about organizations or resources that support Métis people struggling with economic hardship.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Suggested organizations and resources:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Métis Nation Financial Wellness Program: Offers financial education, counselling, and resources for Métis people across Canada.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Métis Nation Employment & Training: Provides career services, training, and job placement support for Métis people.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Métis Capital Housing Corporation: Offers affordable housing programs for Métis people in need.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Métis Child and Family Services: Provides support to Métis families with children who are struggling with economic hardship.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Indigenous Services Canada: Federal government department providing services and programs to Indigenous peoples, including Métis people, struggling with economic hardship.  
[USER] User asked if any of the organizations provide emergency financial assistance.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Confirmed that some organizations provide emergency financial assistance:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Métis Nation Financial Wellness Program: Offers emergency financial assistance to Métis people in crisis situations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Métis Nation Employment & Training: Provides emergency financial assistance to Métis people facing financial hardship.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Métis Child and Family Services: Offers emergency financial assistance to Métis families with children in crisis situations.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Métis Capital Housing Corporation: Provides rental assistance to Métis people struggling to pay rent.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Noted that eligibility and availability of services may vary and recommended contacting organizations directly for inquiries.
